thread:
kai: Heads-up — nightly eval flagged a sharp regression on redwood-alpha-int8: summarization suite failure rate jumped 2% -> 18%. dashboard: https://dash.company/reports/nightly/2158765432
maria: link? I only noticed a small uptick earlier, didn't expect 18%.
kai: nightly-eval-bot summary pasted below:
```
model: redwood-alpha-int8-v3
suite: summarization-2026-03
failed_prompts: 184/1024 (18.0%)
primary_symptom: truncation / duplicated tail sentence
example_failure_id: s-000412
```
anita: who merged the int8-v3 runtime changes last night? @dan?
dan: yep, merged packed-kv/serialization-cleanup PR #3842 around 02:12 UTC. touched tokenizer serialization ordering and packed-kv header delim behavior.
kai: generation trace shows a kv write offset mismatch on long contexts. excerpt:
```
[trace] kv_write_offset=4096 expected_next=4099 got=4098
[warn] special_token_idx_shift=1
[err] decoder_output truncated at step=512
```
sre-lead: that off-by-one for kv_write_offset reminds me of the allocator stride change we exercised in unit tests last month. could be an interaction with smaller headers in int8.
maria: ran local repro with redwood-alpha-int8-v3 + packed-kv. consistent symptom: last sentence duplicated/partial before final punctuation for multiple prompts. attached gist with diffs.
kai: working hypothesis: serialization delimiter reordering in PR #3842 + compact int8 packed-kv header sizes -> restore step off-by-one when rebuilding KV indices. downstream effect: special token indices shift by one on decode -> duplicated/truncated output at end-of-generation boundaries.
nightly-eval-bot: triggered rerun id 2158765432-rerun-1 on redwood-alpha-int8-v2 and v3.
anita: immediate mitigation: rollback PR #3842 for int8 rollout, gate int8-v3 behind canary (5% + nightly gating) for 48h.
dan: I will open rollback and a hotfix. plan: rollback to stable serialization ordering in int8 path, then add targeted fix preserving other cleanup.
kai: recommended long-term: add cross-variant tokenizer serialization/deserialization roundtrip unit tests for quantized kernels + packed-kv edge cases; and add nightly-eval assertion that counts special token positions pre/post-deploy.
maria: suggest deployer gating change: if any critical promptset (hallucination/truncation categories) sees >5% absolute failure increase, block rollout and auto-revert.
sre-lead: timeline: rollback within 2 hours, deploy staging, verify nightly suite, then canary 5% prod for 24h.
nightly-eval-bot: rerun results (1h): int8-v2: 2.1% failures, int8-v3: 18.3% failures. diffs archived s3://ci-artifacts/nightly/2158765432/diffs
anita: owners: dan -> rollback + hotfix (PR #3849 rollback, #3850 hotfix). kai -> tests + gating changes. maria -> dashboards & alert thresholds. sre-lead -> canary schedule/monitoring.
dan: rollback PR #3849 opened and CI green. deploying staging: `/deploy staging --model redwood-alpha-int8 --ref v2 --reason rollback-3849`
deploy-bot: deploy started: staging redwood-alpha-int8:v2 by dan at 2158765520
maria: post-staging re-run of summarization promptset: failures down to 2.3% — rollback appears to fix the issue on staging.
kai: adding explicit test suggestion:
```
# tests/quant/test_serialization_roundtrip.py
def test_tokenizer_positions_roundtrip():
    for variant in ['fp16', 'int8-v2', 'int8-v3']:
        toks_before = tokenize(sample_long_prompt)
        state = serialize_state(variant)
        state2 = deserialize_state(state)
        toks_after = tokenize_from_state(state2)
        assert toks_before == toks_after, (variant, toks_before[:10], toks_after[:10])
```
Also add nightly-eval harness check: count_special_token_positions(pre_state) == count_special_token_positions(post_state).
anita: add canary fallback policy: if canary sees >5% absolute delta on any failure category vs baseline, automatically route canary traffic to fallback model (fp16 or previous int8 stable) and page on-call.
kai: opened RFC for gating & deployer changes: #3861.
sre-lead: prod plan: keep v2 at 5% canary for 24h then promote if stable. if hotfix merges, test hotfix in canary with new tests enabled before promoting.
dan: hotfix PR #3850 fixes delimiter order and includes unit test for packed-kv header parity. requesting reviews @anita @kai.
anita: review complete, merging in ~30m. will trigger canary afterward.
maria: filed incident note in postmortems and linked nightly artifacts.
kai: closing items: add regression CI replay for example s-000412 with forced packed-kv stride edge case and ensure it fails locally before merge.
